task: Bulk fee-pricing editor views + URLs + single-row form template

details.fee_pricing_view: FeePricingView(RoleRequiredMixin, View) allowed_roles=[Roles.ADMIN]. GET: loads active classes + terms ordered -start_date; if class_id & term_id present, get_object_or_404 both (school-scoped) and builds existing dict keyed by category_id; context: classes, terms, categories, existing, selected_class_id, selected_term_id, selected_class, selected_term. POST: class_id/term_id required (else messages.error + redirect fee_pricing); school-scoped existence check for class/term (else messages.error + redirect); inside transaction.atomic() iterate all school categories: empty amount_<pk> -> delete existing FeeStructure row; non-empty -> Decimal parse (invalid/negative -> per-category messages.error + skip, no abort); valid -> update_or_create. Success message 'Pricing saved for {class} — {term}.' then redirect fee_structure_list.
details.fee_structure_edit_view: FeeStructureEditView(RoleRequiredMixin, View) allowed_roles=[Roles.ADMIN]. GET: get_object_or_404(FeeStructure, school=school, pk=pk) -> renders fee_structure_form.html with {'structure', 'classes', 'terms', 'categories', 'is_edit': True}. POST: validates all four fields present, school-scoped existence for class/term/category, Decimal parse + negative check, duplicate check excluding self (messages.error 'A structure for that class, term and category already exists.' + re-render), otherwise updates fields, saves, success + redirect fee_structure_list.
details.fee_structure_delete_view: FeeStructureDeleteView(RoleRequiredMixin, View) allowed_roles=[Roles.ADMIN]. GET: get_object_or_404 -> renders fee_structure_confirm_delete.html with {'structure'}. POST: captures class/category names before delete, fs.delete(), success 'Pricing removed for {class} — {category}.', redirect fee_structure_list.
details.fee_structure_form_html: CREATED. Mirrors fee_category_form.html: extends base_admin, max-w-2xl, bg-white rounded-2xl p-8 shadow-sm border border-gray-100 card, violet receipt icon header, selects for Class/Term/Category (preserving structure.school_class_id/term_id/category_id), amount number input step=0.01 min=0, Update Structure + Cancel buttons. Handles edit mode only (is_edit=True) — no separate create view exists; bulk editor is the create path.
details.fee_structure_confirm_delete_html: CREATED. Mirrors fee_category_confirm_delete.html: extends base_admin, amber alert-triangle header, summary table (Class/Term/Category/Amount), amber warning box about scope, red Delete Structure button + Cancel link.
